title: Make Claude write like you
summary: How to make Claude write like you, not like the internet.
body: How to make Claude write like you, not like the internet.

AI writing sounds like everyone because it's averaging the whole internet. Give it you instead:
1. Feed it your 3 best posts and ask for your style as rules
2. Turn the rules into a style guide (add your banned words)
3. Use it every time, then do one human pass

Save this one. Follow @manrajtalks for practical Claude tips you can use the same day.
